simple.summary: בֵּית תַּפּוּחַ (Bêyth Tappûwach) means Beth-Tappuach , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 53.

definitions.full: H1054. Beth -tappuach בֵּיתתַּֿמּוּחַ proper name, of a location in Judah ( place of apples ) Josh 15:53 ; — modern Taffûh Rob BR ii. 71 Bd Pal 154 Survey iii. 310, 379 .
